decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, which is early evidence of value, and it fits the firm's modular direction, so keeping this option open costs little relative to its upside.

A mobile slow-speed shredder belongs to the firm's core range, has a dedicated page signalling commitment, and benefits from existing service networks, so the costs of keeping it are low and its prospects are solid.

As the flagship concept embodying the firm's modular and cleaner-technology strategy, its uncertainty is still unresolved after one year, and abandoning it now would forfeit the strategic option before its value can be judged.
A mobile trommel screen complements the shredders within established processing lines, so keeping it costs little and preserves the option value, and nothing in the results so far signals failure.
